name: reload-plugins
title: Reload Plugins
description: Rebuild native Swift Onecast plugins from source (swiftc via build.sh) and restart the app so the new code loads — native dylibs can't be hot-reloaded in-process.
author: sujha

commands.name: reload-plugin
commands.title: Reload Plugins
